'''Sari Danzer''' was a [[Gender/Legends|female]] [[Twi'lek/Legends|Twi'lek]] aerialist for [[Molpol's Traveling Circus]]. When the [[Pilot/Legends|pilot]] [[Vistal Purn]] came to see the circus, he fell in love with Sari and offered her on board his ship, the [[Millennium Falcon/Legends|Millennium Falcon]], and agreed on the condition that the ship can undergo before an inspection. She later [[Marriage/Legends|married]] him.
